name: agentic-rails
description: Agentic Rails marketplace: installable, lifecycle-managed verifiers and guardrails for agentic coding tools.

plugins.name: jobs-done-guardrail
plugins.description: Deterministic completion guardrail: an agent finishing a turn with relevant code changes must pass the project's build and unit tests before handing back to the human. Fingerprint-skips already-validated states. Supports Claude Code and Cursor.

plugins.name: advisor-guardrail
plugins.description: Portable advisor guardrail for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. It requires consultation before the first write and selects Opus High, GPT-5.6 Sol High, or Cursor Grok 4.5 High for the host IDE.

plugins.name: codex-as-critic-guardrail
plugins.description: Cross-vendor actor-critic guardrail for Claude Code and Cursor: executor sessions must consult an antagonistic, read-only GPT-5.6 Sol critic via the local Codex CLI before their first write.

plugins.name: cursor-as-critic-guardrail
plugins.description: Cross-vendor actor-critic guardrail for Claude Code and Cursor: executor sessions must consult an antagonistic, read-only Cursor Grok 4.5 High critic before their first write.

plugins.name: python-uv-guardrail
plugins.description: Deterministic pre-tool guardrail for Claude Code and Cursor: direct python/pip commands are denied with a uv-based retry instruction.

plugins.name: readme-name-guardrail
plugins.description: Deterministic pre-tool guardrail for Claude Code and Cursor: nested README.md writes and Git staging/commits are denied in favor of descriptive filenames.

plugins.name: cursor-as-advisor-guardrail
plugins.description: Cross-vendor advisor guardrail for Claude Code and Cursor: executor sessions must consult a helpful, read-only advisor through the local Cursor Agent CLI before their first write.
